newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early edge.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends firmer, retains early edge.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka retained its early edge to close firmer at 43.7400/7450 to the dollar in interbank trading on Monday in a low-volume session just ahead of new financial year, beginning on Tuesday, dealers said.
The currency opened marginally firmer at 43.7400/7460 per dollar and gained further ground on dwindling transactions.
Interbank call money rates closed at 6.5 to 7.5 percent, slightly up from 5.5-6.5 percent previously, dealers said.
Banks will remain closed for public transactions on Tuesday due to annual closing of accounts.
